_meta.doc: Edit this file to customize all branding and hero copy on the served page. The dev server reads this file fresh on every request to /, substitutes the values into web/index.html, and returns the rendered HTML. No restart needed — your edits are visible on the next browser refresh. Agents personalizing the scaffold should rewrite this file based on the user's actual product.

brand.name: Starter Foundry
brand.tagline: A fullstack starter you can personalize.

hero.headline: Starter Foundry Fullstack App
hero.subheadline: A live web shell plus a typed API seam for the agent to extend.

theme._doc: Optional accent color for the page. Read by personalize.css via CSS custom properties. Use HSL space-separated values for compatibility with hsl() consumers.
